resources.string: Monitors failed screen-unlock attempts (watch-login policy only). IntruderSnap cannot wipe, lock or change the password of this device.

IntruderSnap needs the watch-login policy to be told when an incorrect PIN, pattern or password is entered on this phone\'s lock screen, and to read the system failed-attempt counter. It does not request wipe, lock or password-reset powers: Android\'s standard description below mentions locking or erasing the phone, but IntruderSnap cannot do either. You must deactivate this administrator before you can uninstall IntruderSnap.
Lock-screen monitoring will stop. Failed unlock attempts will no longer be recorded.
